say:3:1533202001:0.text: W-where are we? Did we go the wrong way?

say:4:1533202002:0.text: Let me think... Turn left three times in a row, then turn right three times in a row, call out your names on every step... We did everything according to the instructions, how did it go wrong?

say:5:1533202003:0.text: We should've entered the underworld by now... There should be a path ahead.

say:6:1533202004:0.text: How about we split it? We'll find it faster this way...

say:8:1533202006:0.text: Yeah, don't be stupid. In the stories, every time someone leaves the group, they end up dead!
